note: APPEND-ONLY exceptions of tests/e2e/line-wrap-kit.mjs. Each entry: page (file name), kind (P lone punctuation / W widow / U split number + unit), contains (a text of the finding, at least 4 characters), optional lang and width, reason (why it cannot or should not be changed), added (date).

exceptions.reason: Not punctuation: the line starts with the shell command ./start.sh (a file path that begins with a dot) inside a <code> box; the command must be shown exactly as typed, so the dot cannot be moved or joined to the Thai / English word before it.

The Chinese source link (来源, its own <a>) follows the translated sentence after a whitespace-only gap between two elements; keeping it on the sentence's line would mean moving the last words out of the translated <span>, which the translation layer rewrites on every language switch. The link itself never splits (it is kept whole).

Live dashboard tile: store.js rebuilds it (innerHTML) every second and the run-time translator turns it into English; nav.js joins the number and unit again about 0.15 s after each rebuild, so a measurement can land in that gap. The joined state is the normal state.

Help list on a camera page: the English label 'Inspect now' is a whole text node owned by the run-time translator (lensiq-i18n-rt.js), which nav.js must not split (splitting it would break switching back to Thai); at 393 px only the two words of this label fall on the last line. Not reproduced at the other four widths.
